messages:
marie: Started canary wave 3 for CUDA 12.2 driver on dedicated ap-southeast1 pool at ~11:19 UTC. Immediately seeing tail latency +4x on a subset of h100 nodes and 3 kernel OOMs. Rolling forward or pause? @raj @sara :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary (wave=3) started: driver/cuda-12.2 -> dedicated-ap-southeast1-pool/slotset-7. 10 instances. (build: cuda-12.2-rc3)

raj: Can we get quick triage data before rollback. Please paste dmesg snippets and nvidia-smi for affected hosts. Also ping the NIC team if we see rx/tx errors.

sara: Pasting short logs from canary-3-03 (h100-1):
```
[  +0.000123] NVRM: GPU 0: Xid (PCIe) 64, PID 31245: PTX kernel OOM
[  +0.002345] nvidia: PFIFO timeout on GPU 0
```
`nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.total,memory.used --format=csv` shows high fragmentation: 80% used but many processes at 1-2GB sharded. KV cache sizes not respecting limits.

tony: Network telemetry shows a small spike in retransmits on those racks around the same time as the OOMs, but not global. ethtool counters: rx_errors up ~0.6%. Could be correlated w/ jumbo MTU mismatch after driver change.

lina: If kernel/OOMs are reproducible we should fail back traffic to the cuda-11.8 runtime variant for canaries and pause wider waves. Suggested quick mitigation: update routing policy to prefer fallback-model=cuda11.8 for dedicated tier 'ap-southeast1-dedicated' and scale canary instances to 0.

alec: FYI cost impact if we route to older variant: per-token GPU cost +2.3% due to less efficient kernels, and CPU overhead for fallback ~+15%. But it's cheaper than an outage.

raj: Agreed. Proposed immediate plan :
1) Pause rollout wave 4/5 (if queued)
2) Drain canary traffic from affected nodes (scale down canary-3 to 0)
3) Update routing policy to fallback to cuda-11.8 model variant in ap-southeast1 for 2 hours
4) Collect full /var/log/messages, dmesg, core dumps and NCCL debug logs (set NCCL_DEBUG=INFO)
5) Coordinate a staged re-run once we have root cause.

marie: I'm pausing the pipeline now and scaling canary-3 to zero. @deploy-bot can you confirm the pause? :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: paused rollout: driver/cuda-12.2 (operation id: rlt-2026-11-03-ephemeral). Canary instances scaled down to 0/10.

sara: Uploading logs to /mnt/ops/rollouts/1859998765/canary-3. Quick note: NCCL errors include "unhandled system error" and retries were attempted. Putting NCCL logs + dmesg tarball there.

tony: NIC team looped in (cc @lina). They're checking MTU/frame size mismatches between host configs and switch. If we avoid the new driver path for now we should avoid triggering the bad codepath.

lina: I'll prepare a short fallback playbook to push routing change and rollback hooks. Will include command snippets. Example snippet to force routing to variant: 
```
redwood route update --region ap-southeast1 --tier dedicated --policy="model_variant_preference=cuda11.8,fallback_duration=2h"
```

oncall-bot: oncall acknowledged: infra-oncall paged (severity=low) to inspect canary telemetry window.

alec: Please capture cost delta and post-mortem notes once we have RCA. I'll run a quick estimate on the cost dashboard and post numbers.

marie: Thanks team. Action items assigned: @raj collect dumps, @sara upload full logs (done), @lina prepare rollback playbook (in progress), @alec cost estimate. We'll reconvene in 20m unless new critical hits show up. :thumbsup:
